analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. ModelAutopilotPolicy.swift head 21–23 adds fail-closed hold bounds (0–86400 seconds) and requires a load target for positive holds. Existing consent, live-session/revision, selected-model, expiry, busy, residency, pin, dwell and slot-count checks remain intact (8–42); no supported regression in this validator.
protocol-messages.md head 1355–1380 documents consent-gated capabilities, adoption, holds and closed busy/stall diagnostics; 1465–1479 describes post-lease serving and eviction protection. telemetry-schema.md head 65–72 adds corresponding heartbeat/status documentation, not an event ingestion route. The documented diagnostics contain operational enums, counts and timing rather than prompt content or credentials. No visible change to encryption, cache account scoping, attestation or reward consent establishes a regression (A-001, A-003, A-016; TB-002, TB-007, TB-011; T-041, T-053).
Remaining integration work: ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift is supplied only as metadata plus a truncated orientation patch showing placement reconciliation and snapshot rebuilding. Examine its complete changes with placement lifecycle, command execution, heartbeat encoding and transition supervision: verify consent-gated omission, holds under explicit unload/replacement, adoption permission after lease expiry, and cancellation without premature native-memory release. Those contracts materially affect availability and routing authorization and are not verified here. Documentation and external coordinator links do not prove implementation or deployed compatibility; missing runtime evidence is a coverage limit, not a finding.
